# harmoniq_environment (Data Source)

An environment of a host app, with its freeze state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harmoniq_environment" "production" {
  workspace = "checkout-team"
  host_app  = "storefront"
  slug      = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_app` (String) Host app slug.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Read-Only

- `freeze_reason` (String) Why, when frozen.
- `frozen` (Boolean) Whether changes are frozen now.
- `is_default` (Boolean) The host app's default environment.
- `name` (String) Display name.
